correctness.rationale: A fresh exact implementation generated the open-neighborhood faces from the common-witness condition and checked all oriented Hasse covers. For n=6 it found 8620 faces, 4238 matching pairs and 41940 covers; for n=7 it found 136220 faces, 67723 pairs and 839580 covers. Both directed graphs are acyclic. The critical profiles are (1,0,1,142) and (1,0,1,772) with no further cells. Exact oriented cancellation from degree three to degree two reproduced the respective rows with 31(+2), 23(−2), 88(0), and 125(+2), 131(−2), 1(−4), 515(0). Indeed the signed Morse differential uses alternating paths through the matched 2-to-3 incidences, all unit pivots; unrelated dimensions are not needed for this row. Each degree row has gcd 2. The Morse CW model has a single 0-cell, no 1-cells and one 2-cell, so its 2-skeleton is S² and the attaching maps of 3-cells are determined by their degrees. A unimodular change on the wedge of attaching 2-spheres is realized by a homology equivalence of simply connected CW complexes, hence a homotopy equivalence. Its cofiber gives the degree-two Moore space plus 141 or 771 free S³ summands. At n=5 the independently checked profile is one vertex and eleven 3-cells; at n=4 the graph is K4 and the complex the boundary of a tetrahedron. This establishes the asserted first two occurrences in the finite range, not a map between the two cases.
residual_risks: These are exhaustive integer certificates for the stated finite cases, not a formal proof assistant verification and not evidence for any n≥8.
